stem: A worker removes diseased plant material and places the open waste bag in a clean hallway before disposal. What improvement best reduces transfer risk?
choices: Leave the bag open so moisture can escape
Contain and route waste according to the designated removal procedure without staging exposed material in cleaner traffic areas
Move the bag to propagation because it is closer to an exit
Mix clean packaging waste into the same open bag
rationale: Waste handling is part of biosecurity. Containment and controlled movement reduce spread through cleaner areas.
